stem.text: A potentiometer circuit may be used to determine the unknown electromotive force (e.m.f.) $E$ of a cell. The circuit diagrams shown include a battery of known e.m.f. and negligible internal resistance, a uniform resistance wire XY and a galvanometer.
Which circuit diagram shows a suitable arrangement for determining $E$?

A.alt: Potentiometer circuit diagram with a battery, a cell labelled E, a resistance wire from X to Y and a galvanometer symbol.

B.alt: Potentiometer circuit diagram with a battery, a cell labelled E, a resistance wire from X to Y and a galvanometer symbol.

C.alt: Potentiometer circuit diagram with a battery, a cell labelled E, a resistance wire from X to Y and a galvanometer symbol.

D.alt: Potentiometer circuit diagram with a battery, a cell labelled E, a resistance wire from X to Y and a galvanometer symbol.
